cohort: 386 newborns who underwent PICC catheterization in the neonatal department of the study hospital between January 1, 2020 and January 31, 2021.
finding: Birth weight <= 1500 g, durations of PICC stay >= 21 days, 5-min Apgar score <= 7, and femoral vein insertion of PICC were independent risk factors for CRBSI in neonates.
